field.tooltip.allow_splitting: When enabled, this item can be split into smaller parcels or child items.

field.tooltip.country_of_origin: Country where this item was produced or manufactured. Flows to delivery notes and customs paperwork.

field.tooltip.hs_code: Harmonized System code for customs and international trade classification.
field.tooltip.inventory_type: Stocked: tracked in inventory. Non-stocked: purchased/sold but not tracked. Service: no physical stock.
field.tooltip.location_name: The warehouse or storage location this item is assigned to.
field.tooltip.pieces: Number of individual pieces in this stock entry. Separate from sell quantity.
field.tooltip.purchase_conversion_factor: How many of your sell units are in one purchase unit. E.g. if you buy by the box of 12, enter 12.
field.tooltip.purchase_name: The name your supplier uses for this item. Appears on purchase orders.
field.tooltip.purchase_sku: Your supplier's SKU or part number for this item. Used on purchase orders.
field.tooltip.purchase_unit: The unit your supplier sells in (e.g. box, roll, kg). May differ from your sell unit.
field.tooltip.pick_method: Which physical lot to draw down first when selling: FIFO (oldest received), FEFO (soonest to expire), or LIFO (newest). 'Default' uses the company setting. LIFO is US-GAAP only (not permitted under IFRS).
field.tooltip.quantity: The current stock quantity, measured in the sell unit.
field.tooltip.reorder_point: When on-hand falls to or below this level, the item is flagged for reordering. Leave blank or 0 to disable.
field.tooltip.reorder_qty: Suggested quantity to order when below the reorder point, in the purchase unit. Feeds draft purchase orders.
field.tooltip.sell_by: The unit used when selling this item (e.g. gram, piece, carat). Determines how quantity is measured.
field.tooltip.weight: Physical weight of the item for shipping and logistics. Separate from sell quantity.
field.tooltip.weight_unit: The unit for the physical weight field (e.g. gram, kg, oz, carat).
field.tooltip.gross_weight: Packaged weight of one unit, packaging included. Feeds the per-line gross weight on shipping paperwork; net weight is the item's Weight field.
field.tooltip.gross_weight_unit: Unit for the gross weight (e.g. kg or lb).
